events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Jeff Garcia threw for two touchdowns, Ronde Barber returned a fumble for another score and the Buccaneers' defense completely stifled the Falcons 31-7 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs smack Falcons, seize control of NFC South

events.name: St. Louis Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Though the St. Louis Rams still have problems, they're nothing compared to the San Francisco 49ers' historic woes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams edge 49ers in matchup of struggling teams

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Scoring touchdowns on their first seven offensive possessions and getting the eighth on a turnover, the Patriots won their 10th straight game, routing Buffalo 56-10 Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots keep perfect year intact with romp of Bills
